title: cleome tetrandra var. simplicifolia
intro: Cleome tetrandra var. simplicifolia, commonly known as Spurred Cleome, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. This plant is used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Cleome tetrandra var. simplicifolia include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
